_doc: Shadow-trial cases for ops/release/adjudicate.py. false_fail: a qwen2.5-coder:7b FAIL on an Auditor-CLEAR head whose findings the diff contradicts (HUMAN_DEPENDENCIES.md, 2026-11-04); findings copied verbatim from each review's job log. true_fail (real): a head the Auditor HELD; only #642 carries a real qwen FAIL finding, the others carry the Auditor's HOLD reason as the finding (#607 dropped: head sha not found; #655 left out on the Auditor's word). true_finding (synthetic: true): an accurate description of a real CLEAR diff, NOT a defect; it tests that the rule never refutes a true statement and never counts as a real catch. Enforcement is proposable only with >= 20 true cases ruled (>= 10 real) and true_fails_cleared == 0; false_fails_cleared is reported beside it. reviewer_failed: the independent reviewer itself voted FAIL on that head (Auditor 21:12Z: only those count as real evidence of qwen's error mix; today that is #642 alone).
